cc:Work.dc:description:
Stackable storage for hobby paint or other things
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes PaintStorage --x 110 --y 200 --canheight 45 --candiameter 20 --minspace 6 --hexpattern 1 --Stackable_height 3 --Stackable_holedistance 1.5 --thickness 4 --burn 0.05 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes PaintStorage --x --y --canheight --candiameter --minspace --hexpattern --Stackable_height --Stackable_holedistance --thickness --burn --reference --labels
